name: at
description: The at package provides delayed job execution and batch processing. It is required for Linux Standards Base (LSB) conformance.

package:
cat > $DESTDIR/etc/pam.d/atd << "EOF"
# Begin /etc/pam.d/atd

auth     required pam_unix.so
account  required pam_unix.so
password required pam_unix.so
session  required pam_unix.so

# End /etc/pam.d/atd
EOF

post_install: id -u atd >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -d /dev/null -c "atd daemon" -g atd -s /bin/false -u 17 atd
